role.roleTitle: Rollout Project Manager, Warehouse Robotics Deployment

evidence.text: Took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking at each site over a weekend and the first live picking shift on the Monday morning.

Ran the hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with the customer's shift leaders and handled the stoppages raised during hypercare; the stoppage log for each site records the cause, the fix and who cleared it.
Coordinated the installation schedule with field engineering for each site in the six weeks before go-live, holding the weekly installation review with the field lead.
Ran the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer on the installed system at each site, with the acceptance record signed by the customer's operations manager before cut-over.
Wrote the site closure report for each warehouse, listing the known limitations of the system at that site, the open items for remote support and the hand-over conditions agreed with the customer.
